title: The Street Fighter's Last Revenge
writer: Kôji Takada, Masakazu Shimura, Shigehiro Ozawa
actors: Shin'ichi Chiba, Reiko Ike, Kôji Wada
plot: Mercenary karate master Tsurugi is hired to retrieve a cassette tape which holds a very sensitive recording of governmental corruption. A back and forth game of who got the tape ensues.
